attrs.why_open: RE-OPENED AT R6.1 BY THE READING, not by new evidence. ARG-ELIM-1PA-REDUCTION eliminates this doubt, and that elimination argument carries its own open doubt (DEF-ELIM-1PA-IMPL-FIDELITY: that FED-1PA-DEC-IMPL decides the property FED-1PA-CORE names rather than a neighbouring one). Under R6's `eliminative` reading an unresolved doubt was not an attack, so the elimination stood and this label read `eliminated`. GPT-5.6 ruled that too permissive and Assurance 2.0 agrees: an undeveloped defeater leaves what it attacks unsupported until it is resolved. Under `active_unresolved` the open doubt about the eliminator defeats it, and the doubt it was eliminating comes back. NOTHING WAS LEARNED ABOUT THE REDUCTION — what changed is that the artifact stopped calling a contested elimination settled.
